name: v286_equity_comp_overhang_clean
hypothesis: Lower option-award overhang and fewer new option grants reduce future dilution risk; forfeitures/expirations reduce the overhang.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * option_award_outstanding_count / (cap / close), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * option_awards_granted_count / (cap / close), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(option_award_forfeitures_expirations_count / (cap / close), 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unrecognized_compensation_cost_nonvested_stock_options / assets, 126), industry)

name: v286_equity_award_cost_discipline
hypothesis: Lower share-award expense and falling unrecognized compensation cost indicate less equity-compensation dilution pressure.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * share_award_expense_total / sales, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unrecognized_compensation_cost_nonvested_awards / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(unrecognized_compensation_cost_nonvested_awards / assets, 126), 126), industry)

name: v286_credit_line_capacity_repayment
hypothesis: Companies with available credit capacity, line repayments, and lower outstanding facility use should carry lower short-term financing stress.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(credit_facility_remaining_capacity / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(line_of_credit_repayments / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * credit_facility_outstanding_amount / assets, 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt_issuance_proceeds_2 / assets, 126), industry)

name: v286_model_bfl_lowcrowd_rebalance
hypothesis: Low-alphaCount blended factor surfaces may capture a smoother model consensus that is less crowded than direct value/profitability fields.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_total, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_growth, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_quality, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(multi_factor_static_score_derivative - multi_factor_acceleration_score_derivative, 60), industry)

name: v286_news18_low_impact_novelty_fade
hypothesis: Low-impact and low-novelty news under modest event crowding may mean temporary attention noise rather than durable information.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(story_event_record_count, 60) < 0.65, 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_impact_projection_score, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * global_event_novelty_score_2, 90), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * nws18_ssc_fast_d1, 90), industry) + 0.15 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns * (volume / adv20), 10)), -1)

name: v286_pension_restruct_special_clean
hypothesis: Lower pension, restructuring, and special-item adjustments relative to assets indicate cleaner reported earnings quality without using the ordinary EPS/OI carrier.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(fnd6_newqeventv110_pncwippq) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(fnd6_newqeventv110_rcaq) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(fnd6_newqeventv110_spiopq) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_quality, 126), industry)
